### Drivability

Jaecoo 7 Petrol – with 1.6T engine delivering 275NM torque, the Jaecoo 7 offers ample power for the road ahead.

Jaecoo 7 SHS & SHS-H with 1.5L Turbo Super Hybrid engine, the Jaecoo 7 SHS-H offers the best of both worlds with a high output motor delivering fast acceleration with the economy of a electric engine with the 1.8KW hybrid battery.

[See more](https://omoda.foleon.com/brochure/omodajaecoo-7/drive-power)
